roles.student: Nemotron proposes experiments, updates hypotheses from receipts and submits evidence.
roles.host: Execute bounded probes, enforce budget, preserve history and independently replay claimed findings.
roles.codex: Repair generic runtime and public contracts; audit evidence and longitudinal signals. Do not provide held-out solution sequences.

loops.discovery: Run one continuing taught student episode in small bursts. Resume completed model calls from the same episode; do not run a baseline at every step.
loops.evaluation: Use a separate fresh baseline/taught pair only at declared lesson/runtime milestones, with equal ceilings and frozen holdout. Preserve failed and infrastructure-interrupted runs.

transport_policy.shared_state: All roles of a run must use the same CheckpointLedger database. Other processes using other databases are not globally rate limited by this adapter.
transport_policy.retryable: Explicit HTTP 429 only, after persisted cooldown and within unchanged total budget.
transport_policy.unknown_outcome: Timeout, 5xx, broken response or interrupted in-flight request remains unknown. No automatic resubmission; reconciliation is required.
transport_policy.auth_or_configuration_error: 400/401/403/404/422 remains rejected until configuration is fixed through an explicit new attempt policy.
transport_policy.catalogue_calls: Provider catalogue discovery is outside the completion adapter and must be recorded/budgeted separately.
transport_policy.budget_reset: Opening the same database never resets its budget. The adapter does not automatically create a new budget.

dependency_injection: model configuration and absolute transitive source manifest
resume_contract.identity: Bind condition, lesson, public task, max steps, model configuration, transitive target source hashes, runner and checkpoint code hashes. Import frozen source snapshots for a run.
resume_contract.same_episode: Replays durable responses only when the full request at the same role/position matches. A cache replay does not create a new statistical sample.
resume_contract.scope_limit: Whole-episode replay is supported only for deterministic fresh-state local suites. External side effects need a separate durable tool-action ledger and reconciliation before this approach can be used.
resume_contract.scheduler: The active runner automatically resumes bounded bursts and cooldowns until completion, stop condition or persistent deadline. No recurring scheduler is installed.

signals.name: transport availability
signals.measure: logical calls, exact adapter attempts, explicit throttles, unknown outcomes, known token usage
signals.interpretation: Infrastructure failures are excluded from student performance denominators.

signals.name: valid experiment fraction
signals.measure: passed or violation experiment results / unique submitted probes
signals.interpretation: Invalid input is a construction problem. Zero valid experiments provides no evidence about target reliability.

signals.name: feedback recovery
signals.measure: an error followed by a valid experiment / observed error-to-next-experiment opportunities
signals.interpretation: Early exit without another experiment is separately visible; it is not a successful correction.

signals.name: verified discovery
signals.measure: novel student probe, two fresh matching replays, distinct passing control and separately cited review
signals.interpretation: Never promote a narrative claim, a duplicated training input or a cached replay into a new discovery.

signals.name: trajectory correctness
signals.measure: final state correctness, earlier prohibited publications, completion claim and runtime completeness kept separate
signals.interpretation: A later repair cannot erase an earlier prohibited effect.

signals.name: retention and regression
signals.horizon: across lesson versions and later episodes
signals.measure: same declared anchor IDs, target/model/runner/budget scope, fresh student conversations and independent verdicts; report old and new anchors separately
signals.implementation_status: Design only. Current imported data has no repeated anchor evaluation establishing retention.
signals.interpretation: Changed budgets, runtimes, targets or missing evidence make a comparison ineligible. Regression remains a candidate until repeated under matched conditions.

memory_policy.transport_cache: Exact continuation replay, never teaching material or a new sample.
memory_policy.student_notes: Unverified hypotheses may be stored as hypotheses, separate from validated findings.
memory_policy.promotion: Only independent replay plus control and provenance can qualify a finding.
memory_policy.contradiction: Preserve both observations, invalidate reusable qualification, schedule bounded verification through the coordinator. Do not overwrite old evidence.
memory_policy.holdout_boundary: Keep hidden policies, expected outcomes and private target manifest out of student messages.

validation.command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_student_runner tests.test_student_runtime tests.test_teaching tests.test_teaching_dynamic -q

next_integration: Connected via examples/teach.py --student-resume. Use --resume with the same output directory; saved budgets, deadline and snapshot are retained.
